notes.title: Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle Update Ver.1.0.0.2 Now Available
notes.notes:
A patch "Ver.1.0.0.2" has been released to resolve the following issues:

Fixed a problem that prevented the game from starting up properly in some countries and regions for the Steam version of Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle.

notes.title: Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle November Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/fcf7a44c0945fa2515a1caef3bca0d1737682325.jpg

Captain Commando has heard the community’s feedback and will be implementing an update for Capcom Beat ‘Em Up Bundle in November.

New Screen Filters – Transport yourself back to the arcades with new scanline/arcade filter options.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/3bdd0bef36e952a4584004479b7872289456821a.jpg
Clean full res version here

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/82b87240da206eb1c332c3a8432a750bdbc1398a.jpg
Clean full res version here

New Screen Size – In addition to the full screen size, there is now the option to display the screen in its original size to fit more types of screens.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/ca11ffd23eb97aee69f6a3fdb489ea94e6ebf692.jpg

ON/OFF Toggle for Mid-session Joining – When creating a lobby, there is now an option to turn off the ability for other players to join your in-game session.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/c8a4bae79124d7f03ff0b0ba1fae036edd1b037d.jpg

Once the update is pushed in November, we’ll be sure to notify everyone via the Capcom USA Twitter and Facebook accounts.
